citations.anchor: %s is classified
citations.why: Enumerates every non-private `@orthacms/*` manifest under `packages/` and asserts each name is in the union of CORE_PACKAGES, CORE_DEV_PACKAGES, TRANSITIVE_PACKAGES and every feature's packages — an unclassified package fails as a named case.

citations.anchor: puts no package in two groups at once
citations.why: The "exactly once" half: concatenates all four groups and asserts length equals Set size, so a name in two buckets fails.

citations.anchor: classifies nothing that does not exist
citations.why: Asserts the phantom list — classified names not found on disk, with `@orthacms/cli` explicitly exempted — is empty.

citations.anchor: pins every @orthacms dependency to this scaffolder
citations.why: Renders the manifest with orthaVersion '9.9.9' and asserts every `@orthacms/*` range in dependencies and devDependencies is exactly that string — which rules out a caret, a range and `latest` at once.

citations.anchor: leaves no placeholder or directive anywhere in the app
citations.why: Walks every file of the scaffolded app — not a named list — asserting neither /__[A-Z_]+__/ nor /ortha:(if|ifnot|end)/ survives, and repeats the sweep for four selections (nothing optional, every protocol, SSO, everything at once), which is what reaches the conditional-only modules under apps/server/config/ and the four generated app specs.

citations.anchor: throws on an unclosed block rather than swallowing the rest
citations.why: Asserts applyConditionals throws /unclosed/ on an `ortha:if` with no `ortha:end`, rather than returning the truncated prefix.

citations.anchor: names the file in that error
citations.why: Pins the "naming the file" clause: the thrown message must match /plugins\.ts/, the file name passed in.

citations.anchor: throws on a stray end
citations.why: The unpaired-`ortha:end` clause: asserts a lone end throws /no matching/.

citations.anchor: nests, and an inner block inside a dropped one stays dropped
citations.why: Asserts that with only the inner flag on and the outer off the whole result is empty — the inner block must not leak out of a discarded parent.

citations.anchor: keeps a block whose flag is on, without its markers
citations.why: The kept-block half: the result is exactly 'before\nkept\nafter', so a surviving `// ortha:if` marker line fails.

citations.anchor: drops a block whose flag is off
citations.why: The discarded-block half: the result is exactly 'before\nafter', so a leftover marker line fails.

citations.anchor: leaves exactly one storage adapter selectable by default
citations.why: Filters MEDIA_PROVIDERS on `enabledByDefault && available` and asserts the result has length 1 — literally the invariant.

citations.anchor: starts every opt-in feature switched off
citations.why: Iterates COPILOT_PROVIDERS, SSO_PROVIDERS and the unlocked PROTOCOLS and asserts `enabledByDefault` is false on each — the same three groups the invariant names.

citations.anchor: installs the copilot with nothing enabled
citations.why: With an empty selection, asserts resolvePackages contains copilot-server and copilot-admin and does not contain copilot-provider-fake; since those two are in CORE_PACKAGES the empty selection is the worst case, so it holds for every selection.

citations.anchor: scaffolds no signing secrets
citations.why: Reads the rendered .env and asserts it contains neither SESSION_SECRET nor TOKEN_SECRET.

citations.anchor: restores the dotfiles npm will not publish
citations.why: Asserts the scaffolded root holds `.gitignore`, does not hold `_gitignore`, and that the file contains a node_modules line.

citations.anchor: renames the .tmpl files onto their real names
citations.why: Asserts package.json, .env and README.md exist and that no entry ending in `.tmpl` remains; every *.tmpl in the template lives at the root, which is what this readdir covers.

citations.anchor: keeps the unit specs out of the build
citations.why: Parses the rendered apps/server/tsconfig.json and asserts `exclude` contains '**/*.spec.ts'.

citations.anchor: points Tailwind at the installed packages
citations.why: Asserts the rendered styles.css contains the exact line `@source "../../../node_modules/@orthacms";` and matches no `@source` whose node_modules path carries a glob — both clauses.

citations.anchor: names the Vite config .mts
citations.why: Asserts readdir of the rendered apps/admin contains 'vite.config.mts'.

create-ortha-app:I-16.missing: The config half is pinned by execution — src/lib/generated-config.spec.ts loads the rendered apps/server/config/{copilot-anthropic,sso-oidc}.ts and calls the builders with the key unset, empty, half-set and set. The registration half is not: `copilotProviders(config)` and `ssoProviders(config)` in the rendered apps/server/src/plugins.ts are the code that turns an absent config key into an absent entry, and no test executes them — importing that module pulls in every plugin package and a vendor SDK. So an inverted guard there (registering the provider the config omitted) would be caught by nothing here; it would surface in the generated app's own server-e2e run.
